label: Node.js
summary: Runs a JavaScript app or an npm script.

folder.label: Project folder
folder.hint: Your app's code, with package.json. Node starts here; Zero2Dev keeps none of its own data in it.

port.hint: Your app also gets it as the PORT variable.

extraArgsHint: Added after the script, for your app to read (process.argv). {port} is replaced with the port.

env.name: npm_config_cache
env.help: npm keeps its download cache in the Zero2Dev data folder instead of your user profile.

options.label: Run
options.help: Run a JavaScript file directly, or one of the scripts in package.json such as dev or start.

options.label: Script
options.help: The file Node runs, relative to the project folder, for example server.js or src/index.js.

options.label: npm script
options.help: The name of a script in package.json. npm is taken from the same folder as the selected Node version.

options.label: Restart when a file changes
options.help: Node restarts your app whenever a file it loaded is saved.

options.label: .env file
options.help: Load environment variables from this file (relative to the project folder) before the app starts. Empty: none.

options.label: Allow a debugger to attach
options.help: VS Code or Chrome DevTools can attach to the running app (only from this PC).

options.label: Debugger port
options.help: The port the debugger connects to. 9229 is what editors expect.

options.label: NODE_ENV
options.help: Many frameworks (Express, Next.js) behave differently in production: less logging, caching on.

label: PHP
summary: Serves a PHP site with PHP's built-in web server.

folder.label: Project folder
folder.hint: Your site's code. PHP serves it from here (or from the document root below).

port.hint: PHP's built-in web server listens on it.

extraArgsHint: Added to the PHP command line after the generated ones.

fixed.help: Use the php.ini Zero2Dev writes for this service from the settings below (in its data folder, rewritten on every start).
Run PHP's built-in web server on the port, reachable from this PC only.
The folder the web server serves: the project folder, or the document root below.

options.label: Document root
options.help: A subfolder of the project folder to serve. Laravel and Symfony use public. Empty: the project folder itself.

options.label: Router script
options.help: A PHP file that handles every request that is not a real file (front controller). Empty: files are served as they are.

options.label: Start from
options.help: The php.ini that comes with PHP to start from. The settings below are added after it and win.

options.label: Extensions
options.help: Each one is loaded by a line in this service's php.ini (zend_extension for OPcache and Xdebug).

options.label: Memory limit
options.help: The most memory one request may use. -1 means no limit.

options.label: Largest upload
options.help: The largest single file a form may upload.

options.label: Largest form post
options.help: The largest whole request body. Keep it at least as big as the largest upload.

options.label: Time limit (seconds)
options.help: How long a script may run before PHP stops it. 0 means no limit.

options.label: Show errors in the page
options.help: Print PHP errors and warnings into the page. Useful while developing, never on a live site.

options.label: Time zone
options.help: The time zone date() uses, as a name like UTC, Asia/Kathmandu or America/New_York.

options.label: Xdebug mode
options.help: What Xdebug does. Profiler and trace files go to the service's data folder.

options.label: Start debugging
options.help: On every request is simplest, but makes every page slower while the editor is not listening.

options.label: Editor port
options.help: The port your editor listens on for Xdebug. 9003 is the Xdebug 3 default.

options.label: More php.ini lines
options.help: Anything not listed above, one setting per line as name = value. Added last, so it wins.

label: Go
summary: Builds and runs a Go program.

folder.label: Project folder
folder.hint: Your app's code, with go.mod. Go runs here; Zero2Dev keeps none of its own data in it.

port.hint: Your app also gets it as the PORT variable.

extraArgsHint: Added after the package, for your app to read (os.Args). {port} is replaced with the port.

fixed.help: Compile and run the package in one step.

options.label: Package
options.help: What to run: . is the project folder itself, ./cmd/api a subfolder with a main package.

options.label: Build tags
options.help: Comma-separated build tags, for files guarded by //go:build. Empty: none.

options.label: Keep Go's downloads and build cache in the data folder
options.help: Modules and compiled packages go to data\go instead of your user profile. The first run downloads the modules again once.

label: Java
summary: Runs a JAR or a Java main class.

folder.label: Project folder
folder.hint: Your app's folder. Java starts here, so relative paths like targetpp.jar begin here.

port.hint: Your app also gets it as the PORT variable.

extraArgsHint: Added after the JAR or main class, for your app to read (main's args). {port} is replaced with the port.

options.label: Run
options.help: Spring Boot and most build tools produce a runnable JAR. Use a main class for plain compiled classes.

options.label: JAR file
options.help: The JAR to run, relative to the project folder.

options.label: Class path
options.help: Where Java finds your classes and libraries, separated by ; on Windows. lib\* means every JAR in lib.

options.label: Main class
options.help: The full name of the class with the main method.

options.label: Max memory
options.help: The most memory Java may use for objects, like 512m or 2g. Empty: Java's default (a quarter of the RAM).

options.label: Pass the port as server.port (Spring Boot)
options.help: Spring Boot listens on server.port. Not needed when your app reads PORT itself.

options.label: Allow a debugger to attach
options.help: IntelliJ, VS Code or Eclipse can attach to the running app (only from this PC).

options.label: Debugger port
options.help: The port the debugger connects to. 5005 is the usual one.

label: Caddy
summary: Serves your sites. Zero2Dev manages it.
note: Serves your sites. Zero2Dev writes its configuration from the Sites page; ports and HTTPS are in Settings > Sites and proxy.

fixed.help: Run Caddy with the Caddyfile Zero2Dev generates from your sites.

env.name: XDG_DATA_HOME
env.help: Caddy keeps certificates in the data folder, not in AppData.

env.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
env.help: Caddy keeps its own state in the data folder.

label: nginx
summary: Serves your sites when nginx is the site server.
note: Serves your sites when Settings > Sites and proxy > Site server is nginx. Zero2Dev writes its configuration.

fixed.help: nginx looks for its conf, logs and html folders next to nginx.exe.

label: MariaDB

port.hint: Clients connect here. 3306 is the usual one.

extraArgsHint: Any other mariadbd option, such as --skip-name-resolve. Added after the generated ones.

fixed.help: Ignore any my.ini on this PC, so only these settings apply.
The database files live in this service's data folder.
Listen on the service port.
Only this PC can connect. The root user has no password.
Write the server log to the service log instead of a file.

options.label: Character set
options.help: The character set new databases and tables get unless they name one.

options.label: Collation
options.help: How text is compared and sorted, for example utf8mb4_unicode_ci. Empty: the default of the character set.

options.label: SQL mode
options.help: Permissive quietly fixes invalid values (old WordPress plugins and PHP 5 era apps expect it). Strict reports them as errors.

options.label: Max connections
options.help: How many clients can be connected at the same time.

options.label: InnoDB buffer pool
options.help: Memory used to cache tables and indexes. More is faster for big databases; 128M is plenty for development.

options.label: Max packet size
options.help: The largest single query or row. Raise it when importing big dumps fails with 'packet too large'.

options.label: Log every query
options.help: Write every statement to general.log in the data folder. Handy for seeing what an app sends; slow.

options.label: Log slow queries
options.help: Write queries that take longer than the time below to slow.log in the data folder.

options.label: Slow after (seconds)
options.help: A query that takes longer than this counts as slow.

label: MySQL

port.hint: Clients connect here. 3306 is the usual one.

extraArgsHint: Any other mysqld option, such as --skip-name-resolve. Added after the generated ones.

fixed.help: Ignore any my.ini on this PC, so only these settings apply.
The database files live in this service's data folder.
Listen on the service port.
Only this PC can connect. The root user has no password.
Write the server log to the service log instead of a file.
Turn off the X protocol, so MySQL does not take a second port (33060).

options.label: Character set
options.help: The character set new databases and tables get unless they name one.

options.label: Collation
options.help: How text is compared and sorted, for example utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci. Empty: the default of the character set.

options.label: SQL mode
options.help: Permissive quietly fixes invalid values, as old PHP apps expect. MySQL's default is strict.

options.label: Max connections
options.help: How many clients can be connected at the same time.

options.label: InnoDB buffer pool
options.help: Memory used to cache tables and indexes. 128M is plenty for development.

options.label: Max packet size
options.help: The largest single query or row. Raise it when importing big dumps fails with 'packet too large'.

options.label: Log every query
options.help: Write every statement to general.log in the data folder. Handy for seeing what an app sends; slow.

options.label: Log slow queries
options.help: Write queries that take longer than the time below to slow.log in the data folder.

options.label: Slow after (seconds)
options.help: A query that takes longer than this counts as slow.

label: PostgreSQL

port.hint: Clients connect here. 5432 is the usual one.

extraArgsHint: Any other server setting as -c name=value. Added after the generated ones.

fixed.help: The database files live in this service's data folder.
Listen on the service port.
Only this PC can connect. The postgres user needs no password.

options.label: Max connections
options.help: How many clients can be connected at the same time.

options.label: Shared buffers
options.help: Memory used to cache tables, like 128MB or 1GB. 128MB is plenty for development.

options.label: Log statements
options.help: Which statements appear in the service log.

options.label: Log statements slower than (ms)
options.help: Statements that take longer than this many milliseconds are logged with their duration. -1 turns it off, 0 logs all.

options.label: Time zone
options.help: The time zone for timestamps, like UTC or Asia/Kathmandu. Empty: the one chosen when the database was created.

label: Redis
summary: An in-memory store for caches and queues.

port.hint: Clients connect here. 6379 is the usual one.

extraArgsHint: Any other redis.conf setting as --name value. Added after the generated ones.

fixed.help: Listen on the service port.
Only this PC can connect. There is no password.
Snapshots and the append-only file go to this service's data folder.

options.label: Keep the data

choices.label: In snapshots now and then (Redis default)
Not at all (lost when Redis stops)

options.help: Snapshots can lose the last minutes after a crash. Every write is safest. Not at all is fastest, for a pure cache.

options.label: Memory limit
options.help: The most memory Redis may use, like 256mb. Empty: no limit.

options.label: When the limit is reached

choices.label: Remove the least recently used keys
Remove least recently used keys that have an expiry

options.help: Use a removing policy when Redis is a cache.

options.label: Databases
options.help: How many numbered databases (SELECT 0, 1, ...) Redis offers.

label: Custom command
summary: Any other program, by its path.

folder.label: Working folder
folder.hint: The program starts in this folder, so relative paths start here.

port.hint: The program also gets it as the PORT variable.

extraArgsHint: One value per row. {port} is the port, {home} the Zero2Dev data folder.
